messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGERDUTY - HIGH - auth-service - spikes in /token and /login errors across multiple regions. Alert rate: 4xx/5xx surge + auth-db error traces. Pager: @Sam Lee
Sam Lee: on it. seeing a ton of failed login attempts from ~200k unique IPs hitting token refresh endpoint. looks like distributed credential probe.
Priya Nair: Affected endpoints & clients? are customers seeing failed refreshes? any customer reports?
Sam Lee: internal metrics - spike in token_refresh errors (401/429) and high DB read latency. region EU and NA primarily. no major 500s on frontend but auth throughput saturated.
Miguel Alvarez: I can jump on WAF rules and add protection. suggest immediate aggressive rate cap on token_refresh per src IP and per tenant. also consider temporary stricter captcha flow.
Grace Kim: Support has 3 inbound tickets about users unable to log in. They report many failed OTPs. likely account takeover attempts.
Jake Reynolds: Flagging risk to enterprise tenants. we should notify account owners if we escalate auth restrictions.
Sam Lee: mitigation plan: 1) Apply quick ip reputation block + rate-limit of 10 req/min for /token_refresh. 2) Enable challenge (captcha/2fa) for suspicious IPs. 3) Temporarily disable password grant for client apps showing unusual patterns. 4) Roll out WAF geo throttle for low-signal regions.
Miguel Alvarez: pushing WAF rule now. command:
```
# add temporary rule
wafctl add-rule --name "auth-credential-probe-197300" --match "/token|/login" --action block --src-reputation low --threshold 50
```
Miguel Alvarez: also adding rate-limit in edge config:
```
edgecfg set-rate-limit --path "/token_refresh" --period "60s" --requests 10 --scope ip
```
Priya Nair: Can we do per-tenant backoff instead of global blob? prefer tenant limits to avoid collateral for other apps.
Sam Lee: done — using combined policy: per-ip 10/min + per-tenant 200/min. that should throttle bot farms but keep healthy tenants running.
Grace Kim: Support -> sending template to affected customers indicating we're throttling suspicious traffic and advising password resets for flagged accounts. draft message: "We're seeing suspicious login activity on your account..." ready to send after legal signoff.
Jake Reynolds: legal OK with wording, keep it high level, do not mention 'attack' explicitly.
IncidentBot: Deploy check: waf rule applied in prod-eu and prod-us-west, pending propagation to ap-south.
Sam Lee: Observability - enabling finer auth traces and a new dashboard for token refresh latency/errors. fingers crossed.
Miguel Alvarez: seeing immediate drop in peak request rate from known bad IP clusters ~70% reduction. headroom recovering.
Priya Nair: Any customer impact metrics? Support, how many users impacted?
Support Escalations: ~120 tickets opened in last 30m, majority are automated lockouts. enterprise accounts: 2 have elevated failures, outreach in progress.
Sam Lee: Next actions: keep WAF rule for 2 hours, check for false positives, prepare rollback steps. I'll handoff to night oncall at 1973001460 UTC.
Grace Kim: I've queued the customer notices and added guidance to reset passwords + enable 2FA.
Miguel Alvarez: adding a temporary metric alert to catch resurgence. rule id: auth-credential-probe-197300.
Sam Lee: Handoff: @Miguel will own WAF/rate limits, @Priya will own customer comms and account reviews, @Grace will stay on support coordination. leaving notes in incident runbook.
Priya Nair: I'll follow up with a list of flagged tenants and recommended actions in #support.
Sam Lee: Incident status: mitigated -> partial (throttles in place, service degraded for some flows). severity lowered, oncall handoff in 5.
IncidentBot: Handoff recorded. Handoff ts: 1973001460. Pagerduty incident: PD-84721 closed by Sam Lee (ack -> mitigated, watch mode). :white_check_mark:
Sam Lee: adding retrospective items: review auth token granularity limits, implement adaptive captcha, improve per-tenant anomaly detection. will open tickets after this.
Miguel Alvarez: leaving WAF rule in watch mode for 2 hours then auto-roll to alarm only.
Support Escalations: I'll update the ticket queue and send batch emails to the 2 enterprise customers now.
Sam Lee: thanks all. I'll update the incident doc with timelines shortly.
